jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
At Journal Technologies, we believe our technology can be a force for good in the world ensuring the proper and efficient functioning of some of the most foundational aspects of society - the courts and justice system.

We create and implement enterprise software that supports the administration of justice, currently in the United States, Canada, and Australia. While our eSeries product suite enables governments and their employees to deliver continued foundational court processes, our R&D focuses on leveraging emerging possibilities with technology to improve access and efficiency.

Headquartered in Los Angeles, Journal Technologies is a long-time, wholly-owned subsidiary of Daily Journal Corporation (NASDAQ: DJCO). We also have a major office in Logan, Utah, a team in Melbourne, Australia, an office in Victoria, Canada and a growing number of remote staff across North America.

Under our next generation of leadership, we're implementing a vision for the company that prioritizes building an extraordinary workplace with empowered people at the heart of our business. Great people want to collaborate with great people, and we are actively looking for smart, motivated people who care deeply about the work they do.

Chief Technology Officer

The Chief Technology Officer leads technology strategy, architecture, product development, and engineering across Journal Technologies. This leader sets and champions the technical vision, brings strong product and engineering thinking to every initiative, and ensures the company's platforms remain secure, reliable, and positioned for growth. The CTO works cross-functionally with every department and plays a central role in building out the new technology team described above, helping recruit talent and shape how new ideas are evaluated, developed, and scaled.

What You'll Do

Develop and lead a multi-year technology vision and roadmap aligned with the long-term goals of Journal Technologies and drive it across the organization.
Bring a customer-centric, problem-first approach to product development, ensuring teams deeply understand user needs before committing to solutions.
Identify emerging technologies and market opportunities that strengthen existing products and open new areas of value for the company.
Advise executive leadership on technology investments, build-versus-buy decisions, and potential acquisitions or partnerships.
Define architectural vision and principles, ensuring systems are configurable, repeatable, scalable, secure, appropriately modular, and engineered to upgrade and evolve over time.
Apply platform thinking by promoting reusable services, APIs, and shared components that serve multiple products and business units.
Own the modernization of the Company's technology portfolio, balancing investment in existing platforms with technical debt, modernization, consolidation, and next-generation capabilities.
Lead the engineering organization with a culture grounded in ownership, craftsmanship, continuous improvement, and pragmatic decision-making.
Maintain and advance modern engineering practices, balancing speed of delivery with quality, reliability, and security.
Support our organization-wide transition to Agile methodologies and Scrum-at-Scale.
Serve as a true partner to other departments, building alignment on priorities, timelines, and resources across the organization.
Translate complex technical concepts into clear business terms for non-technical stakeholders, and bring business context back to technical teams.
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing technology organization, including organizational design, leadership development, succession planning, workforce strategy, and recruitment of critical technical capabilities needed for the Company's future.
Ensure appropriate standards for security, privacy, compliance, and data governance, including requirements common to courts, government agencies, and criminal justice systems (such as CJIS).
Oversee technology investment, performance, and operational resilience, ensuring resources are aligned with priorities and systems remain reliable, scalable, and prepared for business continuity.
Establish effective technology governance and risk management, partnering with Security, Cloud Operations, IT, Legal, and business leaders to manage architectural, cybersecurity, regulatory, and third-party technology risks.

Qualifications & Skills

12+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 5 years in senior technical leadership roles (CTO, VP of Engineering, Head of Engineering, or similar).
Proven experience leading and scaling engineering organizations and enterprise software platforms.
Deep expertise in software and systems architecture, including distributed systems, cloud-native design, APIs, and data platforms.
Strong product sense, with experience making customer-driven product decisions.
A track record of setting a compelling technical vision and rallying teams and executives around it.
Proven success working cross-functionally, with excellent communication skills and the ability to engage executives, engineers, customers, and partners alike.
Background in government technology, justice or court systems, legal technology, or other regulated public sector markets is highly desirable.
Experience incubating new products or working in a startup, innovation lab, or venture environment is preferred.
Hands-on experience applying AI, machine learning, and data-driven technologies to real products is preferred.
Experience working within Agile teams or formal training in Scrum or Agile methodologies
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree is a plus.

jobs.title: VP, Engagement Strategy
jobs.description:
About Us

At BGBx
, we're driven by a simple idea: breakthrough thinking creates breakthrough impact. As an independent commercial solutions partner to pharmaceutical and life science companies, we bring together strategists, scientists, communicators, creatives, technologists, and data experts to tackle some of healthcare's most important challenges.

Our teams work across consulting and communications to help clients shape strategy, launch innovations, engage stakeholders, and drive meaningful results throughout the product lifecycle. The work is complex, fast-moving, and deeply connected to improving lives, creating opportunities for curious minds to make a real difference every day.

If you're energized by collaboration, inspired by innovation, and motivated by work that matters, you'll find a place to grow, contribute, and make a meaningful impact at BGBx.

Position Overview

The VP, Engagement Strategy turns brand strategy into connected omnichannel engagement.
This senior leader defines how audience insight, behavioral science, content, media, CRM, field engagement, technology, and measurement work together across the customer journey. The VP leads clients and integrated teams from insight through activation and optimization, while helping grow BGBx's Engagement Strategy capability.

Key Responsibilities

Engagement & Omnichannel Strategy

Lead audience-centered, behaviorally informed omnichannel strategies across HCP, patient, caregiver, payer, and other stakeholder audiences
Translate brand and business strategy into connected journeys, engagement architectures, channel roles, sequencing, triggers, and activation roadmaps
Define how content, media, CRM, field, social, experiential, and digital interactions work together to move audiences toward desired behaviors
Make clear strategic choices and tradeoffs that focus investment on the moments and interactions most likely to create impact

Audience, Content & Experience

Turn research, segmentation, behavioral data, cultural context, and market dynamics into actionable audience understanding
Identify the beliefs, motivations, barriers, decision pathways, and moments of receptivity that engagement must address
Shape content and experience strategy so each interaction has a clear role, purpose, call to action, and connection to what happens next
Maintain the strategic throughline as work moves from strategy into creative development, implementation, and optimization

Measurement & Optimization

Define engagement objectives, KPI frameworks, signal plans, and learning agendas
Design closed-loop approaches that use customer response and performance data to improve content, channels, sequencing, and future engagement
Turn performance findings into clear strategic implications and optimization recommendations

Client, Growth & Team Leadership

Serve as a trusted strategic partner to senior clients and lead executive presentations, workshops, and high-stakes strategic conversations
Lead engagement and omnichannel strategy for pitches, organic growth opportunities, and capability development
Manage, mentor, and develop strategists while raising the quality, consistency, and visibility of BGBx's Engagement Strategy offering

Qualifications

10+ years of relevant experience across engagement strategy, omnichannel strategy, experience planning, digital strategy, CRM strategy, integrated strategy, or related disciplines
Significant pharmaceutical, healthcare, or life sciences experience, preferably in an agency, communications, or consulting environment
Proven ability to lead complex engagement strategy from audience insight and problem definition through activation, measurement, and optimization
Strong understanding of HCP and patient journeys and the strategic roles of media, CRM, digital, social, field engagement, data, analytics, experience design, and marketing technology
Fluency in how personalization, marketing automation, modular content, next-best action, and decisioning can support omnichannel engagement
Strong client leadership, facilitation, executive communication, and strategic storytelling skills
Experience leading pitches, growing client relationships, and managing or developing strategists
Working knowledge of pharmaceutical regulatory, privacy, consent, and compliance considerations

Preferred Experience

Experience across both HCP and patient engagement and across launch, growth, or mature brand challenges
Experience translating global strategy into locally relevant engagement approaches
Practical experience with advanced segmentation, dynamic personalization, closed-loop marketing, or AI-enabled planning and optimization
Experience building or evolving an engagement, omnichannel, digital, or experience strategy capability

Interview Process

Candidates will be invited to discuss two anonymized examples of work they personally led, including one demonstrating end-to-end omnichannel strategy. We are most interested in problem framing, strategic choices, cross-functional leadership, measurement, and impact. Confidential client information and unpaid speculative work are not required.

$200,000 - $240,000 CAD

Actual salary decisions will be influenced by several factors that we use to determine overall fit, including experience (both direct and indirect), education, training, demonstrated qualifications, and organizational need. Salary is only one component of the total rewards package offered at BGBx.

What We Offer

At BGBx, we invest in our people because exceptional talent drives exceptional work. We provide a competitive rewards package designed to support your health, well-being, professional growth, and life outside of work.

Our benefits package for full-time employees typically includes health care insurance, retirement plans, generous paid time off and holidays, wellness benefits, life insurance, learning and development opportunities, and other resources that support our employees throughout their careers. Additional benefits may be available based on your location. Beyond benefits, you'll find a culture built on collaboration, innovation, inclusion, and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on healthcare and the people it serves.

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. An Overview Of This Role

As Director, Analytics Engineering, you'll lead a team of 8 and report to the VP of Data & Insights. You set direction across the data organization, stay close enough to the work to guide technical decisions credibly, and partner with Data Engineering, Data Science, IT, and business leaders.

You Will Have Three Mandates

Build trusted, AI-ready self-service. Deliver a semantic model that answers business questions correctly, with the telemetry, evals, and model flexibility to prove it and keep costs in check.
Set the strategy for how GitLab accesses data. Own the data models, BI tools, and AI access patterns (Claude, MCP servers, Slack agents) that put trusted data in everyone's hands.
Build data applications the whole company relies on. Ship production-grade apps that combine trusted data, APIs, and AI to answer questions dashboards can't.

What You'll Do

Build and own a trusted semantic model, with governed metrics and business definitions, that answers business questions consistently across every tool
Build evals and ground-truth datasets that measure answer quality, and use them to drive improvements and catch regressions
Instrument telemetry to see who uses the semantic model and AI tools, what they ask, and where they get stuck
Build a model-selection harness so GitLab can route work across LLMs and stay flexible on cost and quality
Own data modeling and curated datasets for self-service, with the ownership, data contracts, testing, and documentation that make them AI-ready
Define the AI data access strategy: when to use BI, Claude, MCP servers, or Slack agents, with the governance and security to keep access trusted and reliable
Own the enterprise BI and self-service tools strategy (e.g., Tableau, Omni), including evaluation, adoption, and cost
Build self-service capabilities, such as Claude skills, documentation, and guided workflows, that help people find and use data on their own
Build and own company-wide data applications, from Claude-built single-page apps to apps inside BI tools, that combine Snowflake data, API calls, AI-powered deep dives, and write-back to Postgres or Snowflake
Set engineering standards for data apps (security, authentication, testing, deployment, and monitoring) so they're reliable at company scale
Set a long-range roadmap tied to company strategy, and a lightweight operating model that balances urgent stakeholder needs with investment in reusable data products and tech-debt reduction
Hire, coach, and retain a high-performing team of 8: build career paths, develop leaders, distribute ownership, and recognize great work
Act as customer zero for GitLab and GitLab Duo in data workflows, sharing feedback with Product and Engineering

What You'll Bring

12+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or BI, including 5+ years leading teams and 2+ years managing managers or senior leads
Deep expertise in data modeling and semantic layers (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, Snowflake semantic views, LookML, Cube), and expert dbt, including testing and CI/CD across a multi-team project
Hands-on experience building LLM-powered data access (text-to-SQL, agents, MCP servers), including evals and telemetry for answer quality, and advanced use of AI coding agents such as Claude Code
Expert SQL and strong Snowflake experience; working knowledge of Python
Strong data governance experience: data quality, lineage, certified datasets, and access controls (RBAC, row access and masking policies)
Track record of leading cross-functional data initiatives from strategy through adoption and measurable business impact, including enterprise BI and self-service at scale
Systems thinker who sees how models, pipelines, and architecture decisions connect, and designs for second-order effects
Exceptional communicator who writes clear technical specs, sets a clear vision, makes trade-offs visible, and influences executives and peers across the company
Pragmatic in ambiguity: makes sound decisions on emerging technology and ships the right next version rather than waiting for the ideal end state
Able to use GitLab, thrive in an all-remote, asynchronous company, model GitLab's remote working competencies, and work in line with GitLab's values

Nice to Have

Experience with LLM routing or gateway tools and managing model costs
Experience with Tableau, Omni, or a BI platform migration
Experience with web app development (e.g., React, TypeScript) and Postgres
Experience owning finance or revenue-critical data (e.g., ARR, consumption) where accuracy and auditability are non-negotiable

About The Team

Analytics Engineering makes GitLab's data trusted, easy to find, and ready for anyone to use, whether they ask a dashboard, Claude, or a Slack agent. We own the curated data models, the semantic layer, the self-service tools, and the data applications that let teams answer their own questions.

AI is changing how people get to data. Questions that once went through an analyst now go straight to AI tools, so the answers are only as good as the data models and business definitions behind them. Our job is to make those answers correct, consistent, and measurable.

jobs.description:
Socomec Group (Socomec) is a global leader in electrical equipment engineering and manufacturing, specialized in low voltage energy performance.

Socomec North America (NAM) is Socomec’s organization overseeing all operations in North America.

About This Role

This role requires a strong understanding of the power/electrical industry and the realities of complex engineering projects, including project timelines, technical dependencies, resource constraints, and cross-functional coordination. The PMD must also bring strong people leadership and project management experience to create structure around engineering teams, remove obstacles, and allow technical leaders to stay focused on engineering and delivery.

The Project Management Director (PMD) ensures consistent, transparent, and disciplined execution of all projects across Socomec PCO North America. This includes both product development and operational initiatives, ensuring that schedules, budgets, risks, and deliverables remain aligned with business priorities and approved baselines.

The PMD ensures that multi-functional and multi-location teams operate under a unified governance framework, with clearly defined interfaces, expectations, and accountability.

At the strategic level, the role ensures schedule predictability, cost control, and risk visibility across the portfolio - providing management with the insight required to make informed and timely business decisions.

Key Responsibilities And Accountabilities

Governance & Accountability

Ensures that every project operates under clearly defined governance boundaries for scope, schedule, and budget.
Ensures that limits of delegated authority are defined, communicated, and understood by all participants.

Project Planning and Execution

Develop comprehensive project plans outlining scope, objectives, timelines, and resource requirements.
Execute project plans, monitor progress, and ensure that projects are delivered on time and within budget. Ensures that all proposed changes are assessed for cost, schedule, and risk impact before submission for approval.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, manufacturing, quality control, and external vendors. Ensures that resource assignments, time estimates, and major milestone activities are agreed upon.

Team Leadership

Lead, mentor, and motivate a multidisciplinary project team, fostering a collaborative and high-performance work environment.
Effectively communicate project objectives, expectations, and updates to team members and stakeholders.

Risk Management

Ensures that projects maintain an active risk and issue register, that mitigation and containment plans are documented, and that escalation occurs promptly whenever delivery or budget objectives are at risk.

Stakeholder Communication

Establish and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including senior management, clients, suppliers, and regulatory bodies.
Provide regular project updates and reports to senior management and stakeholders.
Ensures accurate, live visibility of project and portfolio status, enabling stakeholders to access progress, risks, and resource utilization through the business intelligence environment without the need for manual reporting.

Budget Management

Develop and manage project budgets
Control expenditures, and take appropriate measures to ensure that the overall business plan is achieved

Quality Assurance

Ensures that all project management activities align with the Quality Management System and that documentation supports internal and external audits.
Conduct regular reviews and audits to ensure compliance with quality standards.

Safety

Develop and promote a culture of prevention across the project team
Assess risks at the earliest stage and implement the appropriate means of prevention
Update, inform and apply safety guidelines

Essential Qualifications, Experience, And Skills

Minimum of 8-10 years of experience in project management, with a focus on high-power UPS systems or related technologies.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Project Management, or a related field.
PMP (Project Management Professional) certification is highly desirable.
Demonstrated success in leading and delivering complex engineering projects on time and within budget.
Proven experience in project management, particularly in the field of high-power UPS systems.
Strong technical background in electrical engineering with an emphasis on power systems.
Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Familiarity with relevant industry standards and regulations.
Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize effectively.
Successfully cultivated and managed strong relationships with key market stakeholders.
Excellent communication skills (written and verbal), interpersonal skills and networking/collaboration abilities.
Focused on the achievement of strategic goals; consistently meets or exceeds targets.
Manages risks; anticipates and communicates in advance any potential issues and their impact.

A monthly close that is reliable and consolidated across Canada and China, landing by business day 10

Investor reporting: the financial model and board and investor updates

A seat at the leadership table

Build it right, then make it better. People's safety rides on what we ship, so we test hard and never settle for good enough.

This isn't for you if

You want a playbook handed to you
You need a big team before you can move
